metadata.technology_reasoning: Gravity-displacement steam autoclaves are the most common type used in medical and laboratory sterilization due to their simplicity, effectiveness, and widespread adoption. They use steam to sterilize equipment and rely on gravity to displace air, making them a standard in hospitals and labs worldwide as of 2024.
